### Hezekiah's Failure
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/hezekiahs-failure
Passage: Isaiah 39:1-8
Points:
- Despite being an exceptionally righteous king, Hezekiah proved he was not the ultimate Messiah Judah needed.
- Showing his treasures to Babylonian envoys revealed a temptation to court foreign allies instead of proclaiming God's deliverance.
- Isaiah prophesied that Judah's accumulated wealth and royal descendants would eventually be carried into exile in Babylon.
- Hezekiah's moral failure demonstrates that believers must not treat God merely as an emergency aid during crises.
- True faithfulness requires ongoing daily obedience and total reliance on the Lord when times are good.

### Bible Pathway - August 8
Author: Bible Pathway Ministries
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/biblepathways/bible-pathway-aug-8-2013.html
Passage: Isaiah 39:8
Points:
- Hezekiah's life highlights how spiritual highs and lows often stem directly from our choices.
- Flaunting the nation's treasures to Babylonian visitors was a serious lapse in judgment that invited future conquest.
- Confronted by Isaiah, the king accepted God's prophetic judgment with humble thankfulness rather than selfish disregard.
- Believers must stay vigilant against spiritual pride and complacency following great blessings.
- Followers of God should turn to Him continuously through both hardships and seasons of prosperity.
